content.comment_body: I recently purchased [product_name] [article_no] [version_no]. I am trying to install it on Linux Mint but am facing difficulties as it won't start when I run the start.sh script. I attempted 'chmod +x /Setup.bin' and './Setup.bin' but received a file readonly error. The installation works fine on Windows XP, but I want it to run on both of my PCs. I checked forums and found discussions about issues related to Java, mentioning the need to delete a certain path, but it’s not clear which file to modify.
Please use the English forum for communication.

Navigate to the folder where your file is located. ```sudo chmod +wrx Setup.bin bash Setup.bin``` If this solution doesn't resolve your issue, could you provide links to related forum threads that describe your problem?
A new question published by [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread titled 'Need help to execute the command for [product_name] installation.' Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user is having trouble installing [product_name] [version_no] on Linux Mint; the installation process fails when attempting to execute the setup scripts and shows a file readonly error. There is uncertainty regarding required Java configuration changes. The user notes that installation on Windows XP is successful and wants to use the software on both platforms.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for straightforward installation and operation of [product_name] [version_no] on both Windows and Linux, without complicated troubleshooting or platform-specific issues.
